acceptance: Each CI example installs and runs `benchbox --version` on a clean image, shown by running it in a container for at least the generic shell steps
description: `docs/advanced/ci-cd-integration.md` examples run `uv pip install benchbox[all]` right after installing uv, with no `uv venv` first. In a fresh CI image that has no active virtual environment, `uv pip install` refuses to install into the system interpreter, so the example would fail unless `--system` is added. Check each example on a clean runner image (GitLab, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure examples; the GitHub Actions ones too) and add `uv venv` plus activation, or `uv run --with benchbox[all]`, or `--system`, whichever the page's own conventions favour.
